summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping, which declares required fields, secret fields, and the Airflow-to-dbt field mapping, and overrides only the profile property (auth_type oauth, env-var references for client_secret and client_id). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py (import, __all__, and profile_mappings directly after the token entry). Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, since the instructions prohibited running repository code; verification was by reading only. The hand-written expected YAML in the profile test is the most likely point of mismatch. Nothing was committed.
